title: The Budget Hack Banks Are Hiding
script:
Have you ever noticed how your checking account balance seems to mysteriously shrink every single month, even when you swear you haven't been buying anything crazy?

Banks rely on a silent, clever system that makes saving money feel like climbing an uphill battle while they quietly profit off your cash flow.

The hidden hack they don’t want you to know about is automated sweep and fractional yield routing, which keeps your money moving into high-yield instruments instead of sitting dead in a zero-percent checking account.

Traditional banks take your hard-earned deposits, lend them out to others at high interest rates, and hand you a microscopic fraction of a percent in return.

To beat this system, you need to set up a smart routing rule where every dollar exceeding your weekly spending threshold automatically sweeps into a high-yield account or short-term treasury fund.

This simple automation forces your idle cash to work around the clock, generating passive returns that completely bypass traditional banking traps. Stop letting commercial banks profit off your hard work for free. Hit subscribe to PocketIQ and let us master your money together.
